component.name: NavigationGroupTest
component.script:
Function init() m.nav = m.top.findNode("NavigationGroup") m.currentIndex = 0 m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onFocusChange") End Function
Function onFocusChange() if m.top.isInFocusChain() and m.top.hasFocus() m.nav.setFocus(true) end if End Function
Function onKeyEvent(key, press) print "key = "; key; " press = "; press if press = true
' Tab Navigation if m.top.mode = "tab" if key = "up" or key = "left" m.currentIndex = m.currentIndex - 1 if m.currentIndex < 0 m.currentIndex = m.top.viewIds.count() - 1 end if print "tab index "; m.currentIndex m.nav.show = m.top.viewIds[m.currentIndex] return true else if key = "down" or key = "right" m.currentIndex = m.currentIndex + 1 if m.currentIndex >= m.top.viewIds.count() m.currentIndex = 0 end if print "tab index "; m.currentIndex m.nav.show = m.top.viewIds[m.currentIndex] return true end if end if
' Stack Navigation if m.top.mode = "stack" if key = "OK" template = m.top.stackTemplates[m.currentIndex] if template = invalid template = m.top.stackTemplates[0] m.currentIndex = 1 else m.currentIndex += 1 end if if template <> invalid newView = CreateObject("roSGNode", "NavigationGroupTestPoster") newView.setFields(template) newView.id = newView.id + Rnd(500).toStr() print "Adding new node type "; type(newView); "."; newView.subType(); " and uri "; newView.uri print "newView = "; newView m.nav.pushView = newView return true end if else if key = "rewind" m.nav.popView = true return true end if end if
end if return false End Function
